persona: Mid-level Siebel developer with EAI and Open UI work
resumeText:
Kavitha Ramesh | Chennai | kavitha.ramesh@example.com

SUMMARY
Siebel CRM developer with 6 years on Siebel 8.1 and IP17 for banking and telecom customer service teams.

EXPERIENCE
Siebel Developer, Marina Bay Technologies, Chennai (2021 - present)
- Configured business components, applets and views in Siebel Tools for the service request module.
- Wrote Siebel eScript in business services and built Siebel workflow processes for order validation.
- Built Siebel integration objects and data maps for inbound web services from the billing system.
- Loaded EIM tables to migrate 2 million contact records from the legacy CRM.
- Tested SOAP web services with SoapUI and fixed XML mapping errors.
- Fixed production defects raised by the support desk and deployed monthly releases.

Associate Developer, Vaigai Software Services, Madurai (2019 - 2021)
- Wrote Oracle SQL queries on Siebel tables to check and correct account data.
- Customised Siebel Open UI screens with JavaScript physical renderers.

SKILLS
Siebel CRM, Siebel Tools, eScript, EAI, EIM, Open UI, Oracle SQL, JavaScript

EDUCATION
BE Computer Science, Anna University, 2019
